author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body: effectiveInstallToken bypasses the features featuremgmt.FeatureToggles parameter and evaluates the flag via openfeature.NewDefaultClient() with context.Background() and an empty EvaluationContext. This diverges from the established pattern in the repo (using TransactionContext(ctx) / centralized feature evaluation) and can ignore targeting attributes. Consider using the already-available features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagPluginsDedicatedInstallToken) (or passing a caller context into this helper) to keep evaluation consistent and avoid relying on a global OpenFeature client here.

author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body: newInstallPluginOpts now always uses c.PluginInstallToken() as the Grafana.com token. This drops the previous behavior where sso_api_token (c.GcomToken()) was used when no dedicated install token is configured, and it conflicts with the PR description’s promised fallback. Consider using the dedicated token only when it’s non-empty (and otherwise fall back to c.GcomToken()), so grafana-cli plugins install/upgrade continues to work for instances that only have sso_api_token configured.

author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body: gnet_proxy_token introduces a new secret-like setting, but RedactedValue only redacts keys matching patterns like API_TOKEN$ / AUTH_TOKEN$ etc. GNET_PROXY_TOKEN won’t currently match any of those patterns, so this value can be exposed via settings dumps/logging (e.g., /api/admin/settings and env override logs). Please update the redaction patterns to cover this key (e.g., add a PROXY_TOKEN$ pattern or broaden token matching) so the new token is consistently redacted.

author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body:
In defaults.ini, other token settings use an explicit empty string value (e.g., sso_api_token = "", gcom_api_token = ""). gnet_proxy_token is currently left blank, which is inconsistent and can be interpreted differently by tooling that parses defaults. Consider setting it to "" for consistency with other token defaults.
  
    
      
        Suggested change
      
    
    
      
          
            
            gnet_proxy_token =
          
          
            
            gnet_proxy_token = ""
